ktms.label: KTMS
ktms.note: Postgres and Redis (its config and limit stores) run as separate containers and are not counted.

litellm.label: LiteLLM
litellm.note: One Uvicorn worker per core, master key only, no database.

bifrost.label: Bifrost
bifrost.note: Client keys are not enforced in this setup. Pricing datasheets are served from local files.

portkey.label: Portkey
portkey.note: One Node.js process as shipped (no cluster mode); using all cores would take one replica per core behind a load balancer. Provider is chosen by request headers; the client key is forwarded upstream. Its per-request log handler cannot be turned off.

kong.label: Kong AI Gateway
kong.note: Kong Gateway OSS 3.9 (the last open-source line), DB-less, ai-proxy plus key-auth, response buffering off.

apisix.label: Apache APISIX
apisix.note: Standalone YAML mode, ai-proxy plus key-auth.

higress.label: Higress
higress.note: All-in-one image: its memory includes the bundled control plane (API server, controller, pilot) next to Envoy.

aigw.label: Envoy AI Gateway
aigw.note: Standalone `aigw run`. Client API-key auth fails in v1.2.0 standalone, so it runs without client auth.

agentgateway.label: agentgateway
agentgateway.note: Strict API-key auth, access log off.

newapi.label: New API
newapi.note: Release-candidate tag (no newer stable release). Per-request consume logs and the CPU overload guard are off. Its access log cannot be turned off.

plano.label: Plano
plano.note: No client auth. Requests pass Envoy, brightstaff and a WASM filter. Its access log cannot be turned off.
